svg.title: Cloud Coordination Hub target AWS architecture
svg.desc: Undeployed CloudFormation target: HTTPS ALB in two public subnets, EC2 Auto Scaling across two private subnets, shared DynamoDB through a gateway endpoint, and CloudWatch monitoring.
svg.text: Implemented CloudFormation target — AWS deployment not yet verified.
Public subnet A · Availability Zone A
Public subnet B · Availability Zone B
Auto Scaling Group · min 2 / desired 2 / max 3 · CPU + request scaling
Private subnets have no default internet route, public IP, SSH ingress, NAT, or package downloads.
Public route table → Internet Gateway. Optional SSM / ssmmessages endpoints for management.
Status: local application, concurrency and two-process failure tests verified. AWS ALB / ASG / HTTPS / CloudWatch not verified live.
Official AWS architecture service icons © Amazon Web Services. Diagram: Cloud Coordination Hub, November 2026.
